_comment: omni-members.example.json -- the members an Omni gateway offers, shaped for a ghostwheel node such as gw19.
Copy to /etc/inputloop/omni/members.json and edit the paths and users. Each member is one stdio MCP server,
started as 'user' (the gateway runs as root and drops to it), with 'env' added to that user's environment.
Its bearer token is /etc/inputloop/omni/tokens/NAME (omni-gateway --mint NAME writes one and prints it once).
Only what is named here runs; the gateway is not a shell. omni-gateway --check starts each and lists its tools.

seat._comment: vibrobeast's memory seat (mentcached), as the person whose seat it is; MENTCACHED_SEAT names it.

tavern._comment: Tavern's own MCP face, as the tavern service user, on the node's data folder; --as is the handle it speaks under.

gitcha._comment: Gitcha's extension server, as a user who has run `gitcha login` once (the device token lives in that home).
